name: Experienced
desc: Wild Pokémon give experience when caught
source: Prof. Juniper at Inhore University / Inhore City

name: Happy Heart
desc: Increases the friendship of wild Pokémon after capturing them

name: Second Chance
desc: Moves that miss do not consume PP

name: Imprisonment
desc: Prevents your Pokémon from following you outside its Poké Ball
source: Boy at Rest Area / Route 406–407, Esmerald City passage

name: Experience +
desc: Wild encounters and Trainer Pokémon give more experience when defeated
source: Prize Exchange Center — 30000 coins / Central City

name: Farmer
desc: Increases the growth rate of Berry trees

name: Berrylogist
desc: Berry trees yield one extra berry when harvested

name: Incubator
desc: Decreases the number of steps needed to hatch a Pokémon Egg

name: Baby Sitter
desc: Increases the chances of Pokémon at the Day Care producing an Egg

name: Item Holder
desc: Increases the chances of wild Pokémon holding an item

name: Super Learner
desc: Increases the experience gained by Pokémon at the Day Care

name: Complication
desc: Increases the level of all Trainers' Pokémon by 1

name: Simplification
desc: Lowers the level of all Trainers' Pokémon by 1

name: Miner
desc: The hammer and pickaxe of the Mining Kit damage the walls of the Mines a bit less, delaying their collapse

name: Treasure Hunter
desc: Slightly increases the rarity of the treasures dug in the walls of the Mines with the Mining Kit

name: Super Lure
desc: Slightly reduces the difficulty of fishing

name: Catch 'Em All
desc: Randomly makes it easier to catch wild Pokémon depending on the number of Pokémon registered in the Pokédex
source: Scientist at the National Park & Route 410 passage

name: Fog Lamp
desc: Slightly reduces the effect of fog on Pokémon accuracy

name: Phenomenal
desc: Some wild Pokémon may appear in phenomena

name: Antidote
desc: Prevents poisoned Pokémon from losing HP outside of battle

name: Fountain of Youth
desc: Contact with water restores the HP of Pokémon in your party

name: Clairvoyant
desc: Reveals the opponents' HP during battles

name: Dowsing
desc: Emits sounds when approaching a hidden item

name: Money+
desc: Trainers give a greater reward when defeated
source: Prize Exchange Center — 30000 coins / Central City

name: Effort+
desc: Wild encounters and Trainer Pokémon give more effort points when defeated
source: Prize Exchange Center — 30000 coins / Central City

name: Friendship+
desc: Pokémon gain friendship more quickly
source: Prize Exchange Center — 30000 coins / Central City

name: Normativity
desc: Increases the catch rate of regular Poké Balls
source: Ace Trainer (F); show a Shiny Pokémon at Inhore University

name: Stealth
desc: Trainers won't immediately spot you when you run nearby

name: Infestation
desc: Wild Pokémon appear wandering in tall grass
source: Prof. Oak after completing the Pokédex

name: Exp For All
desc: Shares the experience gained in battle among all Pokémon in the party

name: Rockbreaker Feet
desc: Allows you to break the small, brittle rocks by stepping on them
